g.text: Raise checkout ranking cutoff for high-risk carts
change_01 · revision 7 (immutable) · opened 2d ago by r.okafor · 3 subjects in 2 repositories (3 PRs)
blocked — CLAIM-2 test Evidence missing (m.linden) · CLAIM-3 PII review failed (j.reyes) · your review is requested
server-projected · lifecycle, verification, approval and override stay separate below
Review changes ▾ — Comment · Approve · Request changes
High-risk carts are being captured too readily. This raises the ranker cutoff so borderline
carts are held for review instead of captured.
checkout shoppers with risk_band 4–5 (~2% of carts)
held carts rise ~0.6% → ~2.2%; capture errors fall
revision 7 · immutable · linked from Subjects as #subjects
Two subjects are stacked PRs in acme/checkout; the third is a second repository. Branch names are never identity.
3 · all required · resolution derives from Verifier results, never typed by a person
Checkout stays correct for high-risk carts
No new personal data leaves checkout
